Understanding Running vs Starting Watts

Running watts (also called rated watts) is the continuous power an appliance needs to operate. Starting watts (also called surge or peak watts) is the extra power needed to start motor-driven appliances.

Tips for Accurate Calculations

  • Check appliance labels for exact wattage
  • Motors (pumps, AC, refrigerators) need 2-3x starting watts
  • Add a 20% buffer for safety
  • Don't start all motor appliances at once
